result.title: Learning Regions of Attraction for Transverse Feedback Linearization under Controller Singularities
result.comment: 27 pages (10 main + references + appendix), 1 figure, 8 tables
result.summary: Transverse feedback linearization (TFL) achieves path following by exactly linearizing the error dynamics, but its controller is undefined on a singular set, such as zero speed for a unicycle or zero thrust for a quadrotor. The constrained region of attraction, the set of initial states from which the closed loop converges to the path without violating state or regularity constraints, determines where the controller can be safely activated. Exploiting the exact linear error dynamics, we show that this region is the largest forward invariant subset of the admissible set. We then decompose its state-constrained Zubov value function into an analytically known quadratic cost-to-go and a safety value function. We learn only the latter, by fitted value iteration without infinite-horizon trajectory labels. The resulting estimate combines an inner layer verified by interval branch and bound with a learned outer layer tested on samples. On a unicycle following a circle and a sinusoid and on a planar quadrotor, it covers on average 72.0%, 83.4% and 19.1% of the simulated region of attraction. In comparison, the quadratic cost-to-go and two physics-informed neural network (PINN) solvers of Zubov's equation cover at most 11.3%, 4.0% and 0.0% on average. Code and animations are available at https://gradslab.github.io/roa_tfl

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究横向反馈线性化（TFL）控制器在奇异集上无定义时的受约束吸引域，即能安全激活控制器并收敛到路径的初始状态集合；作者将状态约束下的 Zubov 值函数分解为解析已知的二次 cost-to-go 与待学习的安全值函数，用无需无限时域轨迹标签的拟合值迭代学习，并以区间分支定界验证的内层加采样测试的外层构成估计。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「控制器何时可安全启用」的可容许集刻画与学习式安全值函数，可能为 LVR 中 STOP／激活决策与 latent 状态有效性判断提供线索；「已验证内层＋学习外层」的认证结构与免轨迹标签的值迭代训练可供核查是否可迁移到 latent 推理状态的判定与监督。
